name: Multiresolution Volume Sampling
definition: An adaptive spatial subsampling scheme that progressively reconstructs a 3D time-slice from the 4D base tensor T_c to provide smooth rendering during fast time slider interactions, refining to full resolution when interaction slows.
summary: Multiresolution Volume Sampling is an adaptive subsampling scheme that progressively reconstructs 3D volumes from 4D tensors by computing a subset of values and copying them to fill cubes, enabling smooth rendering during fast interactions.
